news.text: Ten days after the Boston Marathon bombing, a Democratic forum opened on counterterrorism and turned into a fight over Police Commissioner Ray Kelly. Quinn would keep him; de Blasio, Thompson and Liu would not.

voices.headline: From Black voters: "Someone is finally listening"

voices.body: We have said it before: no outsourcing, contract freezes. Whoever wants our vote should show us, not tell us.
